name: The World At Your Feet
label: Quest
description: The World At Your Feet: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: At last year's All-Valley Blacksmithing Championship, all those who watched saw my leg get swept from under me by a cowardly dog from the Venture Co. Foundry. What they didn't know, however, was the reason I was able to continue and ultimately win the tournament: That's right, ornate mithril boots!
I will need to learn how to craft ornate mithril pants for this year's tournament, however, as a Venture Co. Shredder is an entrant! Teach me the way of the pants and learn the way of the boot!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you completed the crafting of the items, friend?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The world will be at your feet, friend! Let them all come at your legs, for you are now unsweepable!
